positions.title: UX Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed multiple consumer facing projects for high profile clients such as Experian and Liberty Mutual Investments using a combination of web development languages and tools.

• Transformed multiple client management tools, through stages of UX design, into optimized web tools that increased site performance and client productivity.

positions.title: Web Developer / Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded and developed a new E-Commerce website using HTML5, CSS3 and Javascript for 2016 release that will target more than 30,000 UCI students

• Created mobile and desktop mock-ups of official site using Adobe Illustrator

• Aided in generating over $200,000 in sales for the store’s annual Halloween Sale
by devising new marketing strategies consisting of interactive marketing emails and graphics

positions.title: Software Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Led a scrum team by maintaining project schedules and tasks as scrum master 

• Constructed CodedUI tests that were used by Sage to test software
implementation goals for their product using C# and mySQL

• Utilized TortoiseSVN to maintain my CodedUI tests and test files

projects.title: Roses & Cigarettes
projects.description: Developed a website for a musical act using Angular.JS, HTML5, & CSS.

projects.title: HackUCI 2014
projects.description:
Developed an web application called Clique at Hackathon at UC Irvine which is a social network for people who want to create and search projects and make or join a team.
Utilized PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, MySQL, and AWS.
